title: Copacabana Beach at Dusk: Jewelry Vendors and the Rio Skyline
description: As the light fades over #Copacabana, beach vendors hang racks of colorful beaded jewelry and crowds gather along the sand under a soft pastel sky. Evening on the beachfront in #RioDeJaneiro is all about people watching, street vendors, beach soccer nets and that glowing city skyline. Real local life and golden hour vibes in #Rio, #Brazil.

title: Salmon Carpaccio in Rio de Janeiro: Where to Eat in Rio
description: Delicate slices of fresh salmon carpaccio, finished with olive oil, pink peppercorns, microgreens, shaved daikon and a charred lime, made for one of the prettiest plates of the trip in #RioDeJaneiro. Rio's restaurant scene goes far beyond feijoada, with fresh seafood and modern dishes around every corner. Save this for your #Rio foodie guide and #Brazil restaurant list.

title: Fresh Salmon Carpaccio with Lime and Microgreens in Rio
description: Fresh seafood is one of the best parts of eating out in #RioDeJaneiro, and this salmon carpaccio with citrus olive oil, pink pepper, herbs and a dried lime slice was a standout. Light, bright and perfect for a hot day in #Rio, it's a must-order for seafood lovers planning a foodie trip to #Brazil.

title: Praça Nossa Senhora da Paz: A Green Escape in Ipanema, Rio
description: Tucked between busy streets in #Ipanema, Praça Nossa Senhora da Paz is a peaceful city park with tall palm trees, a lily pad pond and a sculpture of two dancing figures reflected in the water. Green spaces like this are a hidden gem in #RioDeJaneiro, perfect for a quiet break between the beach and the metro. Add it to your #Rio walking guide in #Brazil.

title: Bronze Statue and Granite Monument in Rio de Janeiro
description: A seated bronze woman in flowing robes and sandals, weathered to a green patina, rests at the base of a granite monument in #RioDeJaneiro. Public art and historic sculpture are everywhere in #Rio if you slow down and look, from city squares to quiet parks. A beautiful find for art lovers and history buffs exploring #Brazil.

title: Close-Up of a Weathered Bronze Sculpture in Rio de Janeiro
description: Up close, this bronze sculpture reveals every fold of fabric and the soft green patina left by years of tropical weather in #RioDeJaneiro. The calm, downcast face and granite backdrop make it one of the most striking pieces of public art I found in #Rio. A moody detail shot for anyone who loves sculpture, history and art travel in #Brazil.
alt_text: Close-up of a bronze sculpture of a woman with short hair and a draped robe, covered in green patina, in front of a weathered granite monument in Rio de Janeiro

title: Street Cat Peeking Over Old Wooden Beams in Rio de Janeiro
description: A curious white street cat peeks out from behind a pile of charred and weathered wooden beams in #RioDeJaneiro. Rio's neighborhood cats are part of everyday life, lounging in courtyards, alleys and hidden corners all over the city. A sweet, candid moment for cat lovers and street photography fans exploring #Rio and #Brazil.

title: The Cats of Rio de Janeiro: A Curious Street Cat Portrait
description: Green eyes, pink nose and a perfectly suspicious stare: this white and tabby street cat watched me from behind a stack of old weathered wood in #RioDeJaneiro. Spotting neighborhood cats is one of the small joys of wandering #Rio on foot. Save this for your cat lovers board and #Brazil street photography inspiration.

title: Chilito Culinária Mexicana: Mexican Food by a Painted Staircase in Rio
description: Under a red Chilito sign and a Mexican flag, this cozy Mexican restaurant in #RioDeJaneiro opens onto a staircase painted in the green, yellow and blue of the Brazilian flag. Craving tacos on your trip? Mexican food in #Rio comes with dappled sunlight, potted plants and a little bit of street art. A colorful hidden gem in #Brazil.

title: Brazilian Flag Staircase in Rio de Janeiro: A Colorful Photo Spot
description: Green, yellow and blue steps covered in white stars turn this staircase into a giant Brazilian flag, framed by blue railings, star-painted planters and lush tropical plants in #RioDeJaneiro. It's one of the most colorful Instagram spots and street art stairways in #Rio, and also a residential street, so be respectful of neighbors. A must-see for your #Brazil itinerary.
